dreamteamer.title: Users
dreamteamer.description: The person work is assigned to — one collection, on purpose, and at the ROOT of the nav. Every owner, lead, seat, assignee and attendee field in every other module points here, so `users` is the join the whole workspace hangs off and must not sit inside anybody's folder. A user is NOT a contact (that is the outside world you deal with; `users.contact` joins them rather than merging them) and NOT an account — nothing here authenticates anybody, so a workspace with one person still has one user. Peers `contacts`, `companies` and `assets`.
